description: Go names of an earlier 1.x release that the generator keeps after the API contract changed the schema they came from, so that code written against that release still compiles (docs/DESIGN.md section 13: a breaking change is a major version). Edited by hand when a spec sync would break such code; the generator fails when an entry no longer applies. params_methods: "resource.method" of a method released without parameters to which the API added optional ones; the method keeps that signature and a companion method, named here in x-didit-sdk style, takes the parameters. type_aliases: a released type name that is now an alias (marked Deprecated) of alias_of, the type the generator produces for the same schema; values lists the released constants of an enum by value.
